title: Anthropic backtracks on a policy limiting Claude Fable 5's ability to develop other AI models, after significant backlash from the AI research community (Maxwell Zeff/Wired)
summary: Maxwell Zeff / Wired: Anthropic backtracks on a policy limiting Claude Fable 5's ability to develop other AI models, after significant backlash from the AI research community — The company changed course after researchers spoke out against the policy, which would have covertly limited Claude's ability to develop competing AI models.
